claude.sample_unit: patients (56 gliomas plus 7 stable FLAIR lesion negative controls)

links.outcome: False positive and false negative rates of AI volumetry with versus without physician review
links.effect: AI without human review had 25% false positives (4/16) and 8.33% false negatives (4/48); with physician review all 7 negative controls were correctly identified as stable.
links.quote: The performance of the volumetric analysis using the change-point method varied significantly depending on whether human review was involved.

links.outcome: Error rates in AI segmentation-based growth detection with versus without physician review and approval
links.effect: Without physician review, 4/16 false positives (25%) and 4/48 false negatives (8.33%); physician review took a median of ~1.18 minutes (mean 2.93) and yielded perfect specificity in controls.
links.quote: Furthermore, AI-generated segmentations—without human review—also identify progression dates earlier than visual inspection, although this comes at the cost of false positives and negatives, underscoring the importance of physician oversight.

links.outcome: Time to tumor growth detection by AI volumetry versus radiologist visual inspection
links.effect: AI with human review detected growth a median of 21 months earlier than visual inspection in the clinical progression group, and 23 months earlier than last MRI in 13/22 clinically stable cases.
links.quote: The results demonstrate that volumetric analysis calculated by AI segmentation followed by human review detects tumor growth significantly earlier than traditional visual inspection by radiologists (median of 21 months, Table 1 , and Figure 1 ).

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-only versus AI with physician oversight for detecting tumor growth
links.effect: AI alone yielded 25% false positive and 8.33% false negative rates, including 3/7 negative controls wrongly flagged; with physician review all 7 controls were correctly stable.
links.quote: In contrast, without human oversight, 3 out of 7 cases were incorrectly flagged as tumor growth.

unlisted_practices: Using AI-measured longitudinal volumetry with online change-point detection to detect glioma growth earlier than visual inspection
